description: Which packaged skills load_skill offers beside a given set of registered tools. A skill whose frontmatter sets `metadata.requires` to a tool name is offered only when that tool is registered; every other skill is always offered. `offered` lists skill names in directory order. The source is tests/shared/skills.json; the copy under pkg-r/tests/testthat/fixtures/shared/ is generated by scripts/sync-shared.sh. Edit the source and re-run that script.
